jsonLead: Kinds with their card templates and add forms as one document. The import makes an independent copy: changes here don't change the base it came from [B12]. To use another base's kinds without copying, add it as a source in Settings. Ready-made schemes (Commentary, Dictionary, Psalter) are the files templates/cogita/*.json in the repository — they are imported here.
noKinds: This knowledge base has no own kinds yet. Add your own — or import a scheme as JSON (e.g. the ready-made Commentary from templates/cogita/komentarz.json, concepts with a learning order from templates/cogita/podstawy.json).
